about: An example content pack. Copy it to content/packs/ (shipped with the game) or user://packs/ (one device) and the game picks it up on the next start: no code changes. This one adds a pilot, a craft, a mod set with three mods, and a pack biome. The smoke test loads it to prove drop-in content works.

pilots.name: Glimmer Wisp
pilots.passive_text: Near misses give much more Dark Matter; glides sink slower.
pilots.blurb: A drifting light from the ice fields. Nobody has ever caught it.

saucers.name: Comet Skiff
saucers.blurb: A light skiff cut from comet ice. Quick and slippery.

sets.name: Aurora
sets.bonus_text: Slipstream charges 30% faster and reaches 30% farther.
